feature_spec.volume: Initial storage at case start; fill = volume/max_vol from topology
feature_spec.water_value: Terminal water value at start+7 days; margins price-water; ratio price/(water+1)
feature_spec.inflow: Hourly flow, 168h mean, elapsed incl. current and remaining incl. current volumes; m3/s times 0.0036 -> million m3 per hour
feature_spec.price: Current, +/-1/3/6/12/24h clamped inside case, horizon stats/rank, daily stats, remaining mean/max; zscore divisor std+1
feature_spec.constraints: Current hourly and maximum across 168-hour horizon
feature_spec.calendar: UTC; annual sine/cosine period 365.25; daily sine/cosine period24
feature_spec.excluded: Commitment labels, calculation time, future historical reservoir volumes, calendar year, row ID

physics.water_value_semantics: Local PDF states EUR/MWh. Interpret as local energy_value_input consistent with official SHOP docs; case-generation code unavailable. No upstream-downstream EUR/MWh subtraction.
physics.head: Initial volume interpolated on YAML vol_head; upstream minus max(plant outlet_line, downstream reservoir head). Songa averages its two supply heads.
physics.energy_equivalent: Approximation 2.725*head*peak turbine efficiency interpolated across head reference curves*peak generator efficiency, MWh/Mm3. Ignores hydraulic losses and joint-unit dispatch.
physics.supply_fraction: (max(initial pool volume-max weekly min-volume,0)+remaining natural pool inflow)*energy_equivalent/(remaining_hours*plant_pmax); omits upstream generation and past dispatch
physics.catchment_inflow_fraction: Sum natural hourly inflow over directed upstream reservoir graph divided by approximate full-plant discharge capacity; omits storage buffering and travel times
physics.spill: max(initial pool volume+weekly natural pool inflow-pool max volume,0)*energy_equivalent/(168*plant_pmax)
physics.switching: Max-sum binary-state DP at representative pmin and pmax; profit=(price-local terminal WV)*power; transition costs from YAML; free start/end states; feature=(best objective forcing on-best forcing off)/power. No water budgets or cascade constraints.

context.source: User main repository src/temporal_features.py and src/price_features.py; independent adapter preserving formulas
context.rank: context_rank_remaining=(number strictly lower + 0.5*number equal)/(168-hour), over current hour through167; flat suffix and final hour rank0.5
context.rank_normalization: Dimensionless context_rank_remaining intentionally lacks price_ prefix and must not be divided by monetary scale
context.neighbor_mean: For6/12/24h, previous=[max(0,h-window),h), next=(h,min(167,h+window)]; excludecurrent; divide by actual available count; empty neighborhoods use current price
context.contrasts: Current price minus each neighbor mean; all12 price_* context columns are monetary and should be normalized with the rest of the case prices
context.fit_scope: No fitting, labels, filesystem reads or cross-case aggregation; compute complete168-hour features before selecting training rows

mathematics.balance: v[t]-v[t-1]+all_outflows-all_upstream_transfers=natural_inflow[t], Mm3; t0 RHS includes initialvolume. Storage stays nonnegative; no water-creation slack.
mathematics.objective: Maximize hourly price*production+sum(global terminalWV*final storage)-bypass/spill costs-softconstraint penalties; divide entire objective by1+mean(abs(price)) for conditioning; rescale duals afterward.
mathematics.PQ: Fixed initial head. Interpolate head from initial individual reservoir volume; outlet=max(outletline,downstream head); Songa mean of its2 heads. Unit-alone quadratic main+ownpenstock loss.257-point discharge grid plus efficiency knots; iterative generator-efficiency interpolation; enforce Pmax and physical curve Qmax; upperconcave hull;4segments beginning at best-efficiency point.
mathematics.negative_prices: All incremental segments use the same average full-discharge energy conversion at negative-price hours, avoiding out-of-order low-efficiency disposal. This is a deliberate linear approximation.
mathematics.terminal: Local CSV EUR/MWh at start+7d times maximum unit best-point MWh/Mm3 in plant plus downstream global terminalvalue recursively. No raw EUR/MWh upstream/downstream subtraction.
mathematics.constraints: Hourly pool minimum is the sum of supplied individual minimum volumes; summed pool maximum storage. Separate minimum bypass flows. Vest minimum includes own natural inflow,Lio discharge and designatedbypass/spill routes. All minimum/maximum violations have penalized slack; physical water conservation exact.
mathematics.penalties: bypass10/0.0036 EUR/Mm3,spill1000/0.0036 EUR/Mm3, bypassmax1000m3/s; soft slackpenalty=1e7+100*max(abs(globalterminalWV)) EUR/Mm3 perhour. YAMLcurrency treated consistent with priceEUR, exact case-generationcurrencycommands unavailable.
mathematics.omissions: No integer commitment,startstop,minruntime,ramping,head trajectory iteration,shared-penstock unit interactions,tunnel flow limits,individual reservoir storage withinpools,convex river flow-cost tables,head-dependent spill curves,or exact SHOPcommands. Pooling is approximate.
mathematics.dual_sign: With stated equality orientation and minimization solver, economic water value=-eqlin.marginals*objective_scale. Unit opportunitycost=(lambda_up-lambda_down)/best_energy.
mathematics.solver: scipy.optimize.linprog methodhighs,threads1,time_limit20s,primal/dual feasibility1e-7; no randomness or learnedparameters
mathematics.interpretation: Features only. LPdischarge and the0.5Qmin heuristic are not claimed to match unknown competition solver configuration.

lp.monetary_schema: All78 exported features are dimensionless. lp_economic_margin=(price-local dual opportunity cost)/(1+mean(abs(case price))); retain lp_* during later monetary normalization. Raw water dual EUR/Mm3 values exist only in diagnostic case archives.

lp_context.source_provenance: Derived only from lp_qmin_ratio_<unit> in the already verified LP cache. add_lp_features must verify cache source/data/artifact hashes before this transform. Trainer must archive this module and retain the upstream LP feature specification.
lp_context.lag_lead: q(case,clip(hour+offset,0,167)), offset=-3,-1,+1,+3; never cross a case boundary
lp_context.neighbor_means: Previous max(0,h-6)..h-1 and next h+1..min(167,h+6), excluding current; divide by available count; empty neighborhood=current q/Qmin
lp_context.week_summaries: Mean q/Qmin, fraction q/Qmin>=1, fraction q/Qmin>0 over all168 hours, repeated per case; exact comparisons, no tolerance or clipping
lp_context.monetary_schema: All126 added lp_context_* columns are dimensionless and must survive later economic normalization unchanged
lp_context.fit_scope: No fitting, labels, filesystem reads, model prediction or LP solving; derive full-case context before training-row sampling
lp_context.interpretation: LP relaxation omits unit switching/integer decisions. Neighbor and week activity summaries help the supervised learner model those corrections; q>=1/q>0 summaries are not commitment labels or hard feasibility rules.
lp_context.deferred: No storage end-minus-current features in this bounded126-column ablation; their separate contribution is unmeasured

normalized.scale_formula: s(case) = 1 + mean(abs(price(case,h))) for h=0..167, in EUR/MWh
normalized.row_order: Complete 168-hour cases; each scale applies only to its own case
normalized.fit_scope: No fitting; per-case known optimizer inputs only; no label or filesystem access
normalized.switching_costs: Normalize previously computed physics switching margins after their fixed-cost DP. This is not exact economic scale invariance: startup/stop costs stay fixed; inverse scale allows the learner to recover their relative importance.
normalized.stabilization: The +1 EUR/MWh denominator offset prevents near-zero price instability. Existing price_over_water uses water+1 and price_week_zscore uses std+1; retain both as requested relative features, despite nonexact scale invariance.
normalized.hypothesis: Relative prices, water values and economic margins generalize across historical electricity-price scales more easily than unnormalized currency values

mathematics.operating_points: All15/7 nonempty active-unit subsets at fixed fractions1/128..128/128 of each unit's maximum turbine-curve discharge; simultaneous main-tunnel/assigned-penstock flow squared losses; interpolate turbine/head efficiency and8 generator-efficiency iterations. Reject nonpositive head, interpolated turbine-flow bounds, Pmin/Pmax violations. Include off origin.
mathematics.hull: Deterministic upper and lower convex hull vertices in plant total discharge/production, retaining each actual point's unit discharge, power and binary active mask. Keep both frontiers for negative-price behavior; no independent incremental segment decomposition of unit allocations.
mathematics.LP: Nonnegative lambda(vertex,hour), sum(lambda)<=1 perplant/hour; unused mass=all-off. Route sum(lambda*Qtotal) exactly once along original plant route, maximize price*sum(lambda*Ptotal). Old independent Tokke/Vinje q variables have zero upper bound. All other7 plants, constraints and initial-head terminal conversions unchanged fromv1.
mathematics.allocation: Unit flow/power/onfraction are convex-weighted vertex allocations. Verify allocations sum to plant Q/P, lambda mass<=1 and old independent dispatch=0. On fractions are continuous relaxed time-sharing features, not binary labels or calibrated probabilities.
mathematics.features: 78 v1-comparable features renamed lpjoint_ plus7 joint-unit on fractions and2 plant active-unit counts, all dimensionless. The q/Qmin and economic-margin denominators retain each unit's v1 initial-head solo curve to preserve a comparable coordinate; this is not a true unit marginal production factor for the joint hull.
mathematics.limitations: Finite common-load grid restricts feasible operating points; convexification permits time-sharing across discrete subsets within an hour. This is neither exactMIP nor full nonlinearSHOP. No startup costs, iterative reservoir heads, head-dependent spill, individual within-pool storage or command-state reconstruction. Feasible polytope/allocations may be degenerate.
mathematics.solver: scipy HiGHS one thread,20s percase, primal/dual tolerance1e-7; no training, seed or tuning

lp_joint.monetary_schema: All87 lpjoint_* columns are dimensionless; preserve during normalization. Joint economic margins retain baseline unit-solo best-energy denominators as comparative predictors, not exact unit derivatives of joint production. On fractions/counts are physical convex allocations, not probabilities forced into labels.
